# Document Templates

Use these templates when adding new governed docs.

- `active.md`: for current canonical baselines and active rules.
- `proposed.md`: for documents that still need an explicit adoption decision.
- `migration.md`: for in-flight cutovers that need a clear exit condition.

Copy the closest template and fill in the metadata before adding body content.

If you use VS Code, Cursor, or another editor that reads VS Code snippets, you can also start from `.vscode/entropy-docs.code-snippets`.
